caption: The drawing depicts a single beaded bag with a gathered, fabric top in a muted red color. The upper portion below the fabric is decorated with small floral patterns in green, red, and blue. The middle section has a horizontal band with a large, detailed floral motif featuring pink and red roses, green leaves, and some smaller yellow and blue flowers, all set against a pale grayish-blue background. The bottom section below the central floral area is bordered by a turquoise line, then follows a pattern of repeating yellow, turquoise, and cream-colored cross shapes set within a deep maroon ground. The overall composition places the bag in the center of a plain, beige background. A small blue monogram or artist's mark appears in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Beaded Bag
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
